Persistence (infrastructure): it builds Prisma queries itself. `note` calls `this.db.loanEvent.create({ data: {...} })` and `eventsOf` calls `this.db.loanEvent.findMany({ where: { loanId } })`, then maps the returned rows into `LoanEvent`. A repository in the persistence layer should own query building and row-to-entity mapping. Transport (presentation): the `eventsOf` signature takes an Express `Request`, an HTTP concern, even though the method never uses it. The file contains no real business rules; it is a thin data-access wrapper placed in the domain layer. I only judged what work the file does, not which layers it imports from, since that is checked separately.
